name: SHADOW paper test bf-b: BrightFunded CFD book with premium carry on 42 BrightFunded coins (Gen121)
registered: 2026-10-20, before the first bf-b paper hour; runs side by side with bf, which stays the main CFD book
what: Hourly forward test of the CFD book: C* (swap-aware), premium carry (CFD coins), trend 4h, Weiss expiry, deleveraging bounce, Coinbase premium; P1 equal risk, 30-day vol targeting. BrightFunded conditions from the MT5 export and support: commission 0.012% per side, spread BTC 0.4 / ETH 2.7 / altcoins 10 bp (assumed), swap-free (all instruments, +10% fee), crypto leverage 1:5 (gross exposure capped at 5x at the paper risk). Prices: Binance perps as the CFD proxy (Dukascopy/Binance correlation 0.94-0.96, Gen77). Simulation only.

frozen.daily_stop: flat for the rest of the UTC day once the day's loss reaches 60% of the 5% daily loss limit (3%), exit 10 bp worse (Gen79 setting)
frozen.costs: commission 1.2 bp per side + spread (BTC 0.4, ETH 2.7, altcoins 10 bp); no swap (swap-free add-on)
frozen.booking: every sleeve as hourly positions x hourly returns; Weiss legs in their bars
frozen.bfb_scale_note: 0.15 / realised vol 2022-26 of the uncapped point-in-time bf-b book (0.8855, computed 2026-10-20)

frozen_ledger: Each completed hour is computed once, with only the data available at that moment, and never revised. Hours computed more than 2 hours after they closed are flagged late.

gate.minimum: 56 days of paper results and at least 2 Weiss expiry events
gate.reconciliation: recompute the period with the final data: hourly portfolio P&L correlation >= 0.99 and |cumulative difference| <= 0.5% of the account; otherwise find and fix the cause before going further
gate.operations: late or missed hours <= 5% of hours; no data errors
gate.performance: z = (paper mean daily return - backtest mean) / (backtest daily sd / sqrt(days)), backtest = the BrightFunded book 2023-01..2026-09 at the same risk. GO if z > -1; EXTEND to 112 days if -2 <= z <= -1; STOP if z < -2 or the paper drawdown is worse than -12%
gate.honesty_note: 56 days cannot prove the edge (one standard error is about the whole expected return). The paper test mainly proves that the pipeline runs live without look-ahead, data gaps or execution surprises.
gate.shadow_decision: after >= 56 days: bf-b replaces bf only if its paper result is not worse than bf's over the same hours AND it reconciles; otherwise it is dropped
